description: A wicker basket of toy bread sits on the table, and a plate to the right holds a green lime-like fruit, a red berry, and a yellow mango-like fruit. The right hand reaches into the basket, pinches and lifts the small red berry out, moves rightward to the plate and releases it, then picks up the curved yellow banana from the plate, raises it slightly, and sets it back down on the plate in a new position.
